description: This file defines an interface JavaScriptConfig in Java that provides configuration settings for the JavaScript message mapping behavior within the Connectivity service. It includes methods for retrieving maximum script size, execution time, and stack depth, as well as an enumeration for default configuration values.

classes.name: JavaScriptConfig
classes.description: Interface defining configuration accessors for JavaScript mapping behavior in Connectivity service.

classes.name: JavaScriptConfig.JavaScriptConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known config path expressions and their default values for JavaScript configuration.

methods.name: getMaxScriptSizeBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum size in bytes for a mapping script to run.

methods.name: getMaxScriptExecutionTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum execution time for a mapping script.

methods.name: getMaxScriptStackDepth
methods.description: Returns the maximum call stack depth for scripts.
